info.title: ONESOURCE Indirect Tax Compliance - Imports API

get.summary: This endpoint is used to list all the existing imports in the system.
This endpoint is used to fetch the status of an import file upload task that matches the input parameters.

delete.summary: This endpoint is used to delete the import task that matches the input parameters.

patch.summary: This endpoint is used to update import status to process the external import files

post.summary: This endpoint is used to import data via API into Returns using an external file (.CSV)

trackingId.description: Tracking id for workbook update status

status.description: Workbook update status (In Progress, Completed, Failed)

error.description: Tracking id for workbook update status

returnDetails.description: Details of returns to be created.

noAutoRollforward.description: Whether Dataset Need to be Rollforward or not.

clientTemplateName.description: Name of client template from which return is created (if Any)

createdBy.description: Name of user who created Dataset

efileQueuedBy.description: Name of user who queued return

efileSubmittedBy.description: Name of user who submitted the return

TRTA.Athena.Models.Api.V4.Datasets.Notes.description: Represents a request object for adding notes or queries to a cell or sheet within a dataset entity.

text.description: The text content of the note or query.

shouldRollForward.description: The shouldRollForward value indicating whether the note should be rolled forward.

location.description: The location of the note, specifying whether it is associated with a cell or sheet.

rowId.description: The row identifier for the cell where the note or query is located.

columnId.description: The column identifier for the cell where the note or query is located.

format.description: Format of value (ex: for date it is yyyy-mm-dd)

acceptMultiple.description: Indicate that value of parameter accepts multiple values to be passed together.

parameters.description: Parameter supplied as input for the report

items.description: Report data, It will only have data when status is Ready.

selectorItems.description: If this field is a selector, the items to select from

sheetContext.description: The sheet context which the field belongs to

blockContext.description: The block context which the field belongs to
